notes: Rapid+ Pro now has monthly, 6-month and yearly plans (from $2.08/month), plus a free trial for everyone — 1 month for new installs, 3 months for existing users. Redesigned Settings into a Chrome-style navigable menu. Fixed pages loading zoomed out, the start page breaking on long site names, and SSL warnings flickering on unrelated page assets. Link/image long-press menu: preview, copy, download and share. Smart segmented downloads for faster large files.

desktop.notes: Rapid+ is now free for everyone, no account or sign-in needed. New: ad & tracker blocker, a For You content feed, a daily digest notification, per-profile PIN lock, scheduled auto-clear, media downloads, a connection-security indicator with Proceed Anyway, removable Most Visited tiles, and reopen closed tab (Ctrl+Shift+T).
